## 1. Architectural Mission
module_id: "mod_security_adaptive_auth_and_mfa"

## 2. Invariant Checklist
- **FIDO2 / WebAuthn Hardware Passkeys**: Cryptographic public-key credentials bound to physical hardware (YubiKey, Apple Secure Enclave / TouchID, Windows Hello), mathematically immune to phishing and adversary-in-the-middle (AiTM) proxy attacks.
- **RFC 6238 Time-Based One-Time Password (TOTP)**: Standard software MFA with encrypted seed storage (AES-256-GCM) and cryptographically hashed single-use recovery codes.
- **Adaptive Risk-Based Step-Up Authentication**: Real-time evaluation of client signals (Geo-velocity impossible travel calculation, ASN/TOR proxy detection, device hardware fingerprint). Triggers mandatory biometric step-up challenges when risk scores exceed normal thresholds.
- **Enterprise Identity Federation (OIDC / OAuth 2.1 & SAML 2.0)**: Seamless single sign-on (SSO) integration with enterprise identity providers (Microsoft Entra ID, Okta, Google Workspace, Keycloak) with automated JIT (Just-In-Time) user provisioning and SCIM 2.0 directory synchronization.
- **Asymmetric Token Lifecycle (Ed25519 EdDSA / RS256)**: Short-lived access tokens (15-minute expiration) paired with stateful refresh tokens backed by automatic reuse detection and instantaneous revocation cascades.
